assets_and_frames.basis: Support is the contact force from the surface on the object (upward, inside the support cone) plus the object's box centroid inside the surface's world-AABB footprint; height is not bounded.

public_clauses: Exactly three fruits must end up resting on the clay plate, each supported by the plate itself with its center over it, counting any fruit that starts there; a fourth fruit on the plate does not complete the task.
Let go of them there: a fruit the gripper still touches does not count.
